## Executive summary: **A fundamental shift (continued)** 





• Our stronger projections for consumption, mainly in China, and the **l f d i d i i** s ower pace o pro uct on recovery compare to our est mates n our LME Week Executive Preview, suggest that the surpluses will be capped in 2010 and 2011.  This will support elevated prices well above the mine cost curve and we no longer anticipate that there will be cutbacks at the mines.  Some smelter curtailments are likely over the next few **y** ears **, p** articularl **y** as the sur **p** lus in the acid

market could see them struggle to dispose of this by-product. • Above average demand growth of about 6% in 2012-2014 will be met **by more modest supply growth** , **leading to deficits and elevated prices** .
